summary: I ran both scenarios live against the real Pokemon TCG API (`bun run db:seed`) — a genuine zero-card failure (API returned 500, exit code 1, clear error with cause/next steps, no 🎉) and a genuine successful seed (500 cards inserted, exit code 0, 🎉 banner + stats) — and recorded both runs with their `echo $?` output in `docs/tickets/seed-script-silent-failure.md` under a new "Manual verification" section, since the code fix itself was already correct from the prior attempt. — researched from the venture's brain (semantic), planned as a PRP with 4 validation gate(s) (resumed), then passed on round 2 of 2 (earlier rounds failed — round 1: validation gates not met — coverage: manually run both the zero-card failure scenario and the normal success scenario end-to-end and confirm exit codes with `echo $?`, since `db/seed.ts` has no existing automated test harness (unlike `src/lib/*.test.ts`) and hits a live external API — note this manual verification in the PR description in lieu of an automated test. (manual verification isn't documented anywhere: current commit e6ec7b7 is unpushed (no PR exists yet for this branch state) and its only docs change is a status-line edit in docs/tickets/seed-script-silent-failure.md, no manual-verification note present)) against them plus tests, /review review pass (0 critical) and /qa: Change only touches db/seed.ts (a one-off CLI seeding script invoked via `bun run db:seed`) and a ticket doc — no route, handler, or UI surface to exercise. No web-facing surface to QA; nothing to test in a browser/headless run..
